stage: 方案04第9节阶段4：仅A组训练和验证，不执行最终测试
numeric_imputation: training median within variable; unseen/all-missing fallback 0 plus missing indicator
categorical_encoding: training-only one-hot variable/type/variable-qualified discrete value; unknown ignored
selection: 固定初始配置，不调参；主指标验证Macro-F1，保留全部结果，不宣布最终模型
test_policy: 不生成测试特征/预测/指标；只核对冻结索引的测试条数及输入文件哈希
